'''Morth''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He was employed in the retail sector, but later made a career for him self as an [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Oluna Biqua]]. Following the release of the gas [[Trinex-M]] in the city during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Morth gained the ability to use [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], and was driven insane by his use of the [[Farsight/Legends|farsight]] [[Force power/Legends|Force power]].
